title: Irish Potato Gratin
description: A comforting, creamy, and delicious potato gratin, perfect for a cold evening. This recipe combines tender potatoes with a rich, cheesy sauce and a crispy topping.
instructions: Peel the potatoes and slice them into 1/8-inch thick rounds.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Sprinkle the flour over the onion mixture and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually pour in the milk, whisking continuously to prevent lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, stirring occasionally.
Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish and create a layer of potatoes.
Pour some of the cheese sauce over the potatoes, followed by a sprinkle of gruyère cheese.
Repeat the layering process, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
Sprinkle with chives and serve hot.
